activity 3 feeling the power 
of deprivation
for you to know
Have you ever been denied something you really wanted? (Of course you have; you’re human, 
aren’t you!) What happens when you want a car but can’t afford one? Or when you have a crush 
on someone who doesn’t like you back?
My hunch is that whatever you wanted and couldn’t have has become really big and perfect 
and incredibly wonderful in your mind. You’re probably thinking about it all the time and imag-
ining how great your life would be if only you could have it. You’re also probably having some 
very difficult feelings about not having it. Am I right?
